name: Work Holiday Pass (Work and Holiday Visa Programmes)
summary: A 12-month pass for Australian and New Zealander students and graduates aged 18 to 30. You apply yourself and do not need a job offer first.

requirements.text: You must be a citizen of Australia or New Zealand.
requirements.listName: Work and Holiday Visa Programme countries

sources.quote: You are a citizen of Australia or New Zealand.

requirements.text: You must be aged 18 to 30 when you apply.

sources.quote: You are aged 18 to 30 at the time of application.

requirements.text: You must hold a university degree, or have completed the equivalent of two years of full-time undergraduate study.

sources.quote: You hold a university degree, or have completed the equivalent of two years of full-time undergraduate university study.

requirements.text: The pass lets you work and holiday in Singapore for up to 12 months.

sources.quote: The Work and Holiday Visa Programmes are for eligible Australian and New Zealander students and graduates who want to work and holiday in Singapore for up to 12 months.

requirements.text: You can only work for companies registered with ACRA or organisations registered with the Registry of Societies, and freelance work is not allowed.

sources.quote: Work as employees of companies registered with the Accounting & Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA).

requirements.text: You cannot work for the same employer for more than 6 months, so a full-time job on this pass is capped even though the pass runs longer.

sources.quote: Cannot work for the same employer for more than 6 months. You can choose to find another employer after that, or spend the rest of the time holidaying.
